Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was seen for neck strain. The reported
mechanism is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the course of care, the patient
completed 18 visits cnosisting of physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction. The
treatment course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of
motion returned toward baseline. Cervical imaging and clinical examination findings clearly support the diagnosis of
cervical strain. The records also show prior treatment to the same region within the past two years. That earlier
condition contributes to some of the current complaints, and this has been considered in the overall assessment.
Billing records were reviewed and show no dpulicate charges for the same services. At discharge, the patient was
improved with residual stiffness on extended positioning, and a home program was provided for continued
self-management.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
